assessment.report:
# Small-task routing: scoped readiness

The user approved default named implementer plus Tester for small code tasks, risk-based Reviewer escalation, task-size-independent applicable workflow obligations, and explicit Lead-only exceptions. Pure consultation/read-only work does not become implementation; trivial nonbehavior typo/format changes may retain Lead ownership. Missing roles never authorize fallback. Team entrypoints remain explicit; no global implicit activation or project AGENTS creation is approved.

Current source role-routing, team-dev, shared execution/handoff templates and acceptance contracts were inspected alongside current architecture, README and release policy. This extends an existing capability within unreleased 0.9.1; no new runtime orchestrator, schema, blueprint, refactor or model change is needed. Docs Maintainer owns instruction edits; Tester owns the packet and isolated regression evidence; Lead owns readiness/index/release coordination; Reviewer will inspect completed diff. Role-selector and task handle evidence are recorded in the packet; tool definitions are not confirmation of resolved inference identity.

Other inventoried documentation is unrelated to this scoped assessment and is not re-certified or declared obsolete. Real future-agent invocation remains pending user testing; package structure validation cannot establish semantic compliance or force runtime routing. No commit, push or actual installation is authorized. Existing uncommitted coverage-sync work remains preserved.
